summary: Separates silencing the room audible indicator from acknowledging or clearing its alarms.
description: Separates silencing the room audible indicator from acknowledging or clearing its alarms. A room DC interface connects station battery distribution, alarm contacts and operating circuits. DC supplies may remain energized when the room's normal AC supply is unavailable, so their source and distribution boundaries must be shown separately.

In a switchroom, the station battery can continue supplying protection and breaker controls during an AC supply interruption. The alarm system should distinguish charger loss from a low battery condition. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Silence request” at the input and “Audible-output silence” at the output. Visual or remote indication can remain active.
